note: The Dalaran Heist Anomaly Mode pool: one anomaly per run. Live save data (the live install's 105 HsRecorder sessions, key 55 / 344): between runs DUNGEON_CRAWL_ANOMALY_MODE_CARD_PREVIEW (392) holds the pre-rolled anomaly the client shows; when a run starts DUNGEON_CRAWL_CURRENT_ANOMALY_MODE_CARD (243) becomes it (whether the run is in anomaly mode or not) and DUNGEON_CRAWL_IS_ANOMALY_MODE (377) the player's pick (246); when the run ends a new preview is rolled (22 of 22 re-rolls differed from the anomaly just used) and 243 / 377 keep the last run's. Every boss game of an anomaly-mode run plays the same anomaly (8 sessions; never Bob's Tavern). Seen as previews: 15 of the 18 (not Fishy, Explosive, Rejuvenating). The client's default (AdventureData.AnomalyModeDefaultCardId) is 55878, Arcane.

sources.quote: Anomaly Mode adds an additional Twist to the selected chapter. The Twist is rolled before chapter selection and can be seen when selecting it.
sources.what: the 18 anomalies by dbfId (its Card query)

sources.quote: start one of the chapters with a certain, random effect that persists through an entire run

anomalies.name: Anomaly - Summons
anomalies.text: After a spell is played, a minion of the same cost is summoned.

anomalies.name: Anomaly - Nesting
anomalies.text: After a minion is played, it gains "Deathrattle: Summon a 1/1 copy of this minion."

anomalies.name: Anomaly - Refreshing
anomalies.text: At the end of each player's turn, that player draws until they have 5 cards.

anomalies.name: Anomaly - Wild Magic
anomalies.text: All spells cast an additional time. (targets chosen randomly)

anomalies.name: Anomaly - Glittering
anomalies.text: After a player plays a card that costs (8) or more, that player adds a Treasure to their hand.

anomalies.name: Anomaly - Gorged
anomalies.text: Both players start the game with two extra cards and Mana Crystals.

anomalies.name: Anomaly - Dragon Soul
anomalies.text: After a player casts 3 spells in a turn, that player summons a 5/5 Dragon.

anomalies.name: Anomaly - Ogreish
anomalies.text: All minions have a 50% chance to attack the wrong enemy.

anomalies.name: Anomaly - Reductive
anomalies.text: At the end of each player's turn, reduce the cost of cards in their hand by (1).

anomalies.name: Anomaly - Hallucinating
anomalies.text: Both players start the game with 10 'Hallucinations' in their deck.

anomalies.name: Anomaly - Growing
anomalies.text: Minions gain +1/+1 at the end of their owner's turn.

anomalies.name: Anomaly - Explosive
anomalies.text: After a minion is summoned, it gains "Deathrattle: Deal 1 damage to all minions."

anomalies.name: Anomaly - Rejuvenating
anomalies.text:
At the start of each
player's turn, that
player restores 2 Health
to their hero.

anomalies.name: Anomaly - Infused
anomalies.text: After a minion is summoned, it gains Taunt, Divine Shield, Rush, or Windfury at random.
